decision_conditions: This permission shall have the effect of varying condition numbered 2 on approved application reference PL/1407/25 dated 26/09/2025. The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: Form 4 – Reasonable Exception Statement, Heritage Statement (Ref. 2507.1777), Location Plan, Proposed Rear Extension The ‘Fallback Position’ Letter (Ref.6158/LL/), 6158 PL-000, 6158 PL-001, 6158 P 010, 6158 P 010 Rev A, 6158 P 012, 6158 PL100, 6158 PL110, 6158 PL110 Rev A, 6158 PL 200, 6158 PL 210, 6158 PL 210 Rev A.

None of the existing trees on the site shall be lopped, topped, felled or uprooted without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.  Any topping or lopping which is approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard 3998 (Tree Work).
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of planning permission PL/1407/25 dated 26/09/2025.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

<p>Prior to the commencement of the relevant part of the works, full details of the proposed green roof shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall not be occupied or used until the works have been completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>

<span lang="EN-US" style="">The roof area of the extension hereby permitted (other
than the balcony/terrace area as shown on the approved plans) shall not be used as a
balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further
specific permission from the local planning authority.&nbsp;</span>
